verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google spend needs structural fixes to contribute.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 35 leads at an average cost per lead of $108.08 — all 35 came from Meta, which is running at roughly $51 per lead. Google Ads consumed $1,983 and produced 1 conversion, meaning that channel is not yet pulling its weight; we are working through the setup milestones that are blocking it from performing. Lead volume surged 83% week-over-week and cost per lead fell 51% in the same window, driven entirely by Meta's recent performance. One separate issue requires attention: 105 inquiries have entered your CRM over this period but zero consultations have been booked, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being followed up or scheduled — we are diagnosing that now. Next period, expect Meta to hold its current pace while we prioritize clearing the Google blockers and restoring the booking flow.
